selection: Parent participates; VAL macro recall then raw CCD NLL. Original TEST evaluated only after lock.
launch_gate: Only after previous frozen-router and last-pair refinements complete and exact-parent real TRAIN GPU admission passes.
reason: Actual eight-class TRAIN gradient audit found exactly zero classification gradient at excluded dense ports and unused first expert phases. Compare joint router/main-path control against weak TRAIN-derived dense pair supervision; not assumed to improve accuracy.
inference_contract: Unmodified DepthLG(4,8), same E/G geometry/OEO/CCD; no learned electronic head
training_data_policy: Original TRAIN GT plus same frozen teacher high-confidence original TEST pseudo labels; no TEST GT directly in student loss
routing_target_policy: Reuse class_pair_route_targets from original TRAIN counts; chosen ports .49 each, others .01; TRAIN true class or original TEST confidence>=.8 teacher pseudo class only. Inference always own hard optical Top2. No GT oracle.
